name: Stage 36:2: Gälkhyttan to Fada kvarn
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 36:2, Gälkhyttan to Fada kvarn.
utilities: Gälkhyttan has small parking/access at the start. Fada kvarn has parking for a few cars and the Fada bus stop at the end, but official notes say buses stop at Fada less often.

Tunakorset is usually the more useful Fada-side bus access, about 1-1.5 km by road. Gälkhyttan-side public transport is weak: Lilla Brakärr is about 2.9 km from the start, while Nyköping C is the distant rail anchor.

Nearby lodging/service options include Äventyrskompaniet at Gälkhyttan, Lasätter Gård off-route from Gälkhyttan, Broby B&B on the Fada/Kiladalen side, and seasonal Palstorps Hage/Skogsby; verify opening and exact pickup/access before relying on them.
waterSources: No verified potable water source was found on stage 36:2. Gälkhyttedammen, Överdammen/Pilthyttedammen and Fadadammen are natural or reservoir water only; treat/filter/boil if used.
Överdammen/Vindskyddskartan-style water references should be treated as unknown-quality shoreline water, not a drinking-water tap or tested spring. Carry enough water from a reliable source.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden planning should treat 36:2 as one stage with two same-endpoint alternatives: a shorter/northern route listed as 7 km and a longer southern/eastern route listed as 9 km via Pilthyttedammen and Överdammen shelter.

The short/northern option should use OSM relation 3696288's main connected component only, about 6.58 km mapped, from the shared 36:1 node at 58.692472,16.809794 to the shared 36:3 node at 58.728950,16.841419. Exclude floating OSM way 889021104; drawing the raw relation naively creates a small disconnected dyke segment near Överdammen.

The long/eastern Överdammen option is not cleanly encoded by OSM relation 3696288. Reconstruct it by replacing the direct way 671203754 between nodes 6088173873 and 914038009 with the eastern loop segment from OSM relation 18434805 (Rundslinga Gälkhyttedammen), giving about 8.65 km mapped and matching the official 9 km planning label.

Naturkartan's 5.1 km geometry appears incomplete for endpoint routing because it does not reliably terminate at Fada kvarn. Keep Sörmlandsleden as authority for the two official alternatives and planning distance.

No current official fault report was found on the stage page during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Adjacent Stage 36:1 has current warnings, but they should be presented as through-hike context rather than Stage 36:2 faults.

The shorter route goes more directly through forest and partly afforested former farmland. The longer route follows Gälkhyttedammen, houses, an old railway embankment, Pilthyttedammen reserve, Överdammen shelter, and a small viewpoint over the dam landscape. The longer/eastern option can be wetter and slower than the distance suggests, but carries the shelter/toilet/fireplace services.

Pilthyttedammen reserve: no tenting; fires only at the prepared fireplace by Överdammen shelter; pets must be leashed; do not damage living or dead trees or shrubs; do not pick plants except berries and edible mushrooms; avoid disturbing wildlife within 100 m of nests/dens.

Stora Bötet is adjacent access context at Gälkhyttan rather than the core 36:2 corridor. No explicit public tenting ban was found on the current Stora Bötet rule page, but group camps/competitions require permission and the general no-damage/no-disturbance reserve rules apply.

Fadadammen and Fada kvarn are the main end-of-stage rest/cultural nodes. Fadarundan says one tent can fit at Fadadammen, but use this cautiously as a single small rest/tent possibility, not a campsite: verify signs, stay outside prohibited reserve areas, and follow allemansrätten.
No verified potable water source was found on Stage 36:2. Gälkhyttedammen, Överdammen/Pilthyttedammen and Fadadammen are natural/reservoir water only and should be treated/filtered/boiled if used.
Older trip reports mention wet grass, overgrowth, mud and slippery boards/rocks around Strogen/Fadadammen/Fada after rain. Treat as seasonal practical caution rather than a current closure.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan stage start
facilities.description: Official start of stage 36:2 and connection from stage 36:1, with small parking/access by Gälkhyttedammen.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan parking
facilities.description: Small natural parking very close to the official stage start. Sources describe roughly 3-5 cars plus a smaller nearby space; it can fill on popular days.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttan firepit
facilities.description: OSM-mapped firepit near the start by Gälkhyttedammen; not listed as the official stage fireplace. Verify locally and observe fire bans.

facilities.name: Gälkhyttedammen natural water
facilities.description: Lake/reservoir water by the start; Naturkartan also marks bathing/ice activity nearby. Not a verified potable source; treat/filter/boil if used.

facilities.name: Stage 36:2 route options
facilities.description: Stage 36:2 has two official alternatives: shorter/northern about 7 km / 6.6 km mapped and longer southern/eastern via Pilthyttedammen/Överdammen about 9 km / 8.7 km mapped. Attach Överdammen facilities as on-route only when the long variant is selected.

facilities.name: Stage 36:2 OSM variant caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 3696288 represents the short connected route plus a disconnected 46 m dyke way. For the long route, combine with Rundslinga Gälkhyttedammen relation 18434805 and replace direct way 671203754 between nodes 6088173873 and 914038009.

facilities.name: Stage 36:2 map-source caveat
facilities.description: Naturkartan's public 5.1 km geometry appears incomplete for Stage 36:2 because it does not terminate at Fada kvarn. Do not use it as endpoint-routing authority.

facilities.name: Överdammen shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter on the longer Pilthyttedammen/Överdammen alternative, not on the short option. Official loop sources and OSM/Vindskyddskartan context report fireplace, dry toilet and firewood nearby; a 2024 group report used it as a coffee-break stop.

facilities.name: Överdammen fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace by the shelter; this is the only permitted fire site inside Pilthyttedammen reserve. Current fire bans still override use.

facilities.name: Överdammen dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet by the Överdammen shelter area on the longer route option.

facilities.name: Överdammen / Pilthyttedammen natural water
facilities.description: Nearby dam/reservoir water only; user shelter maps list water of unknown quality and hiker reports describe lake water rather than a spring. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Pilthyttedammen reserve rules
facilities.description: No tenting in the reserve; fires only at the prepared shelter fireplace; dogs/pets must be leashed; do not damage living or dead wood; plant picking is limited to berries and edible mushrooms; avoid disturbing wildlife within 100 m of nests/dens.

facilities.name: Pilthyttedammen dam caution
facilities.description: Historic regulated dam-water landscape from early iron-working. Treat sluices, dam edges and winter ice as caution points; do not present Fadadammen or Pilthyttedammen ice as safe without current local checks.

facilities.name: No verified Stage 36:2 drinking water
facilities.description: No potable tap or tested spring was verified on Stage 36:2. Bring water or treat/filter/boil natural water.

facilities.name: Strogen/Fada wet overgrowth caution
facilities.description: Older trip reports mention wet grass, overgrowth and muddy fields around Strogen/Fada, especially after rain. Treat as seasonal practical caution rather than a current closure.

facilities.name: Fadadammen rest area
facilities.description: Good rest area near the end before Fada kvarn. Natural dam/lake water only; Fadarundan notes that one tent fits here, but treat it as a single small rest/tent possibility, not a campsite, and verify signs/boundaries.

facilities.name: Fadadammen / Fadabäcken natural water
facilities.description: Dam/stream water near Fada rest area and Fada kvarn; not a verified drinking-water source. Treat/filter/boil if used.

facilities.name: Fada kvarn
facilities.description: Historic mill/forge and dam area, stage end, and connection to stage 36:3. Sörmlandsleden describes the waterfall context as a notable Sörmland feature.

facilities.name: Fada kvarn parking
facilities.description: Parking for a few cars by Fada kvarn; official Fadarundan text asks visitors to park diagonally and mentions an alternate gravel parking area about 1 km onward, but no precise coordinate was verified.

facilities.name: Fada bus stop
facilities.description: Closest paired bus stop at the end, essentially at Fada kvarn, but buses stop here less often according to official notes; verify live Sörmlandstrafiken service. North-side paired stop is at about 58.729086,16.841446.

facilities.name: Harsta korset bus stop
facilities.description: Alternative bus access in the Fada/Harsta corridor, around 1.5 km from Fada depending on route choice. OSM maps paired stops here; verify current Sörmlandstrafiken service.

facilities.name: Tunakorset bus stop
facilities.description: More useful official public-transport access for Fada, about 1-1.5 km road walk from Fada kvarn. Verify live Sörmlandstrafiken departures.

facilities.name: Lilla Brakärr bus access
facilities.description: Closest researched mapped stop to Gälkhyttan, about 2.9 km from the start, but service is sparse and not a normal convenient trailhead. Verify live service.

facilities.name: Brakärr bus access
facilities.description: Nearby line-663 corridor stop east of Lilla Brakärr. Useful only with live timetable confirmation and extra road walking from Gälkhyttan.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Nearest major train station, roughly 12.9 km from Gälkhyttan and 9.5 km from Fada; mark as far/off-route context.

facilities.name: Berga kulle nearby reserve
facilities.description: Nearby/off-route reserve with old pine/spruce forest and Kiladalen views. Only show as nearby context unless the selected variant actually approaches it; reserve rules include no camping, no fires and no riding.

facilities.name: Berga kulle parking
facilities.description: Nearby reserve parking, not a core Stage 36:2 trailhead. Mark as off-route/distant unless route-distance checking shows it lies within the selected variant buffer.

facilities.name: Äventyrskompaniet Gälkhyttan
facilities.description: Gårdshus lodging listed by Sörmlandsleden at/near Gälkhyttan with 6+2 beds; verify availability before relying on it.

facilities.name: Lasätter Gård
facilities.description: Lodging/food-fika by arrangement listed by Sörmlandsleden about 2.5 km from Gälkhyttan, so show as off-route planning context.

facilities.name: Broby Bed & Breakfast
facilities.description: Lodging near Kiladalen Golf listed by Sörmlandsleden for stages 36:2/36:3/44. Coordinate is approximate and may be more than 2 km from the endpoint depending on access route.

facilities.name: Palstorps Hage / Skogsby
facilities.description: Seasonal attraction/lodging/service context on the Fada side, not a core trail facility. Verify opening and access before planning around it.
